office_does: The county clerk keeps the Superior Court's records and handles its filings and court funds.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Chief Deputy Clerk Stephanie George is the only candidate for the seat of retiring Clerk Karen Bowen.

candidates.summary: Chief deputy clerk in the Kittitas County Clerk's Office, running unopposed for the open clerk's seat.
highlights: Chief Deputy Clerk since 2022; briefly interim county clerk in late 2022 [S1]
Promises an organized, responsive and accessible office [S1]
